end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Pongal, and Makar Sankranti.
Explored the link between harvest festivals and the season after crops are ready.
Kavya identified “after harvest” once, but later returned to the idea that festival dates are random.
Practised describing Pongal through its rice dish and cleaning activities; regional celebration details were not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals with the time when crops are ready, using Pongal and Makar Sankranti as examples. Kavya mentioned Pongal’s rice dish and cleaning, and once said it happens after harvest. The mix-up about festival dates being random was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Kavya to put “sowing,” “growing,” and “harvesting” in order, then say when a harvest festival happens.
